hook: Top 3 kaun? LIMIT bolega [[baaki ghar jao]]

slides.title: Top 3 [[kamaane wale]]
slides.code:
SELECT name, salary
FROM employees
ORDER BY salary DESC
LIMIT 3;

slides.title: MySQL vs [[SQL Server]]
slides.note: Standard SQL: **FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY** (PostgreSQL, Oracle mein chalta)

slides.title: Page 2? [[OFFSET]]
slides.code:
SELECT name, salary
FROM employees
ORDER BY salary DESC
LIMIT 3 OFFSET 3;
slides.note: OFFSET 3 = pehli 3 **skip**, agli 3 do. Yahi **pagination** hai 📱

slides.right:
SELECT name, salary
FROM employees
ORDER BY salary DESC
LIMIT 3;
slides.why: Bina ORDER BY ke LIMIT = **koi bhi 3** rows. Top 3 ki guarantee **zero** 🎲

caption:
